g.text: Days before / after nearest full moon
An independent Maldives field study provides a second view of the lunar pattern
Acropora spawning clusters after full moon in both datasets
Sources: Baird et al. (2021), CSD v1; Sheridan et al. (2025), PeerJ 13:e19447, Supplement 4 (CC BY 4.0).
Historical data: one genus/subsite-date. Maldives: 81 spawning atoll-days, representing 3,026 colony observations, Oct 2021–May 2024.
Recording designs and geographical units differ. Day 0–7 is a descriptive comparison; these percentages are not spawning probabilities.
